finding.text: The shots show only the error state, because Servex has not been restarted, so a ready card and its Merge button were never drawn at any width. The card layout (`.rm-body` grid, `.rm-card`, `.rm-merge`) is judged from the CSS alone. Shoot it once after the restart (Requirements 3) — shots/…/1200.png, band 2.

The error text in the shots ("Servex has no merge list yet: it needs a restart") is not the text in diff.patch ("Servex did not answer (…). If this change is new, Servex needs a restart."). The qf-1 worktree holds an uncommitted edit that the diff does not include. Also, the shot's wording names a restart as the cause, but the same message shows for any failure (a timeout, or a 500). The diff's wording is the more honest one (Words 1).

The plan says the page is "linked from the AI dashboard head". The diff puts the link in the dashboard foot (`ad-foot`), beside "Old Inbox →". It works, but it sits below the fold of a long list (Requirements 3).
`mergeBranch` does not check whether `append.mjs` succeeded, and it leaves its temp `merge-log-*.json` file behind. If the append fails, the "merged:" line is lost without any error (Requirements 2).

At 1920 and 3440 the error line uses about 30% of a centred 44em column, and roughly 80% of the screen is empty (`empty 0.79/0.86`). That is acceptable for a one-line state, but it is worth re-checking once cards fill the grid (Layout 1).

Pressing Merge freezes all of Servex until merge.mjs finishes, which can take up to 15 minutes (Requirements 2). `mergeBranch` runs merge.mjs with `spawnSync` and `timeout: 9e5`, inside Servex's own process. Until it returns, every other Servex route, log append and agent supervision waits. The `this.merging` guard can never fire, because no second request is handled while the first one blocks. Fix: run merge.mjs with async `spawn`, or in a child process (diff.patch, Server/ReadyToMerge.mjs `mergeBranch`).

There are no shots: `shots/` is empty, and the last `shots` line in session.jsonl lists four widths but `bands: []`. So the page's look is judged from the CSS and code only; nobody has seen a card or the Merge button drawn. The earlier review's shots showed only the error state.

A card's title can be a bare folder name. If a record's first line has no title, the row falls back to `path.basename(dir)`. `node Server/ReadyToMerge.mjs` today shows the row for `worktree/qf-1` titled "process-system" (Words).

`dayDirs` only walks date folders from the last 14 days. A session folder older than that which logs a fresh `ready:` line is never scanned, even though the file mtime check (`recordFiles`) would accept it. The task folder here is dated 10/20, so it is safe for now.

The branch under review, `task/merge-approvals` (head 8689eeccf), has no `ready:` line of its own yet. The only listed row is `worktree/qf-1 0769cf76e`, so the "own row appears in your list" check from the Land step is still to be done for this branch.
